$comment: Phase 6 passages (docs/PLAN.md §16), written by pnpm themes:build from the approved taxonomy and the pinned datasets. Each passage cites its dataset rows; refs are OSIS in WEBC (English) numbering. Each theme carries the owner’s approval and a fingerprint of its passages.

themes.title: God and creation
themes.description: The one God who makes the world, keeps it in being, and shows himself holy, faithful and glorious.

subthemes.title: Creation
subthemes.description: The making of the heavens, the earth and humankind, and creation's praise of its maker.

subthemes.title: The holiness of God
subthemes.description: God set apart from all that is not God, and the call to be holy in return.

subthemes.title: God's faithfulness
subthemes.description: A God who keeps his word through every generation.

subthemes.title: Glory
subthemes.description: The weight and splendour of God's presence, seen in the tent, the temple and the face of Christ.

themes.title: Covenant and promise
themes.description: The bonds God makes with his people, and the promises that carry the story forward.

subthemes.title: Covenants
subthemes.description: God binding himself to Noah, Abraham, Israel and David, and the new covenant to come.

subthemes.title: The law
subthemes.description: The instruction given at Sinai, and how it shapes a people's life.

subthemes.title: Sabbath and feasts
subthemes.description: Holy time: the day of rest and the yearly feasts that remember what God has done.

subthemes.title: The promised Messiah
subthemes.description: The hope of an anointed king, and its fulfilment as the Church reads it.

themes.title: Sin and turning back
themes.description: How people turn from God, and how they find their way back.

subthemes.title: Sin
subthemes.description: The fall and its spread, and sin named for what it is.

subthemes.title: Temptation
subthemes.description: Trials of desire and loyalty, resisted or given in to.

subthemes.title: Idolatry and pride
subthemes.description: Putting something else in God's place, including oneself.

subthemes.title: Repentance and confession
subthemes.description: Turning around: owning wrong, asking pardon, beginning again.

themes.title: Mercy and forgiveness
themes.description: God's mercy to sinners, and the forgiveness people are asked to pass on.

subthemes.title: Mercy
subthemes.description: Compassion that goes beyond what is owed.

subthemes.title: Forgiveness
subthemes.description: Sins forgiven by God, and forgiving one another.

subthemes.title: Grace
subthemes.description: A gift that cannot be earned.

subthemes.title: Redemption and reconciliation
subthemes.description: A people bought back and enemies made friends again, with God and with each other.

themes.title: Faith, hope and trust
themes.description: Holding on to God in the dark, and acting on what he has said.

subthemes.title: Faith
subthemes.description: Believing God and staking a life on his word.

subthemes.title: Hope
subthemes.description: Looking forward to what God has promised but not yet given.

subthemes.title: Trust and fear
subthemes.description: Trusting God when afraid or anxious.

subthemes.title: Obedience and patience
subthemes.description: Faith that listens, waits and keeps going.

themes.title: Prayer and worship
themes.description: Speaking to God, praising him, and the worship of his people.

subthemes.title: Prayer
subthemes.description: Asking, pleading, listening: people at prayer.

subthemes.title: Praise and thanksgiving
subthemes.description: Song and thanks for who God is and what he has done.

subthemes.title: Worship and sacrifice
subthemes.description: Altar, tabernacle and temple, and the offering of oneself.

subthemes.title: Fasting
subthemes.description: Going without, to seek God or to mourn.

subthemes.title: Baptism and the Lord's Supper
subthemes.description: Washing and the shared meal at the heart of the Church's life.

themes.title: Suffering and comfort
themes.description: Pain, loss and persecution, and God's comfort in them.

subthemes.title: Suffering
subthemes.description: Affliction borne, questioned and lamented.

subthemes.title: Grief and death
subthemes.description: Mourning the dead and facing death.

subthemes.title: Persecution
subthemes.description: Suffering for faithfulness.

subthemes.title: Healing and comfort
subthemes.description: The sick restored and the grieving consoled.

themes.title: Love, family and neighbour
themes.description: Love of God and neighbour, lived out at home and among strangers and the poor.

subthemes.title: Love
subthemes.description: The love God shows, and the love he commands.

subthemes.title: Marriage
subthemes.description: Husband and wife, faithfulness and its breaking.

subthemes.title: Parents and children
subthemes.description: Raising children, honouring parents, families blessed and broken.

subthemes.title: Friendship and hospitality
subthemes.description: Friends, neighbours and the welcome of strangers.

subthemes.title: Justice and the poor
subthemes.description: Fair dealing, and care for the poor, the widow and the orphan.

themes.title: Wisdom and the way of life
themes.description: How to live well before God: wisdom, humility, peace and the right use of things.

subthemes.title: Wisdom
subthemes.description: The fear of the Lord and the practical wisdom that follows from it.

subthemes.title: Humility
subthemes.description: Knowing one's place before God and others.

subthemes.title: Peace and joy
subthemes.description: Peace with God and gladness of heart.

subthemes.title: Self-control and contentment
subthemes.description: Mastery of oneself, and being satisfied with enough.

subthemes.title: Work, money and generosity
subthemes.description: Labour, wealth and its dangers, and open-handed giving.

themes.title: The kingdom and the life to come
themes.description: God's reign breaking in, the Spirit and the Church, and the hope of resurrection.

subthemes.title: The kingdom of God
subthemes.description: God's rule announced, taught in parables and prayed for.

subthemes.title: Salvation
subthemes.description: Rescue and deliverance, from the sea to the cross.

subthemes.title: The Holy Spirit and the Church
subthemes.description: The Spirit given, and the community it gathers.

subthemes.title: Resurrection and judgment
subthemes.description: The dead raised, the world judged, and life with God for ever.
